universalrandomizer.title: Universal Randomizer
universalrandomizer.setup.title: Universal Randomizer — Setup
universalrandomizer.setup.subtitle: Select the gameplay systems to randomize
universalrandomizer.mode.mining_drops.de: Randomizes items dropped when breaking blocks.
universalrandomizer.mode.mob_drops.desc: Randomizes loot dropped by all mobs on death.
universalrandomizer.mode.chest_loot.desc: Randomizes items generated inside naturally spawned containers.
universalrandomizer.mode.crop_drops.desc: Randomizes the harvest output of all crop blocks.
universalrandomizer.mode.fishing_loot.de: Randomizes fish, treasure, and junk caught while fishing.
Randomizes all loot tables tied to structures.
universalrandomizer.mode.crafting.desc: Randomizes the output of all crafting recipes.
universalrandomizer.mode.smelting.desc: Randomizes results from furnaces, blast furnaces, and smokers.
universalrandomizer.mode.furnace_xp.desc: Randomizes the XP awarded when smelting items.
universalrandomizer.mode.block_placement: Randomizes what block is actually placed when the player places a block.
universalrandomizer.mode.entity_spawns.d: Randomizes which entity type spawns in place of intended spawns.
universalrandomizer.mode.villager_trades: Randomizes emerald costs and trade outputs for all villager professions.
Randomizes the potions produced by the brewing stand.
universalrandomizer.mode.enchantments.de: Randomizes enchantments applied at the enchanting table and from loot.
universalrandomizer.mode.loot_tables.des: Global loot table replacement — every loot table is swapped with another.
universalrandomizer.mode.advancement_rew: Randomizes the items and XP rewarded when completing advancements.
